faqs.q: How do I create a new habit?
faqs.a: Tap the "+" button on the home screen, enter your habit name, choose a category, set a schedule and reminder time, then save. Your habit will appear on the dashboard immediately.

faqs.q: How does streak tracking work?
faqs.a: Complete your habit each day to build a streak. The app tracks consecutive days and rewards you with badges and visual progress indicators. Missing a day resets your streak, but your overall history is preserved.

faqs.q: Can I track tasks as well as habits?
faqs.a: Yes! Habiteazy supports both habits (recurring) and tasks (one-time to-dos). You can manage them from the same dashboard.

faqs.q: What is the difference between Free and Premium?
faqs.a: Free users can track up to 3 habits with basic stats. Premium unlocks unlimited habits, advanced analytics, widgets, watch support, and an ad-free experience.

faqs.q: How do I use the widget?
faqs.a: After adding habits, long-press your home screen, select Widgets, find Habiteazy, and add it. The widget lets you mark habits complete without opening the app.

faqs.q: Can I see detailed statistics and reports?
faqs.a: Yes! Go to the Stats tab to view daily, weekly, and monthly completion rates, streak history, heat maps, and trend charts.

faqs.q: How do reminders work?
faqs.a: Set custom reminder times for each habit. You can choose specific days, multiple times per day, and the app will send push notifications at those times.

faqs.q: Does the app support smartwatch?
faqs.a: Yes, Premium users can view and complete habits from their Apple Watch or Wear OS device.

faqs.q: How do I reorder or organize my habits?
faqs.a: Long-press a habit on the dashboard and drag to reorder. You can also group habits by category for better organization.

faqs.q: Can I set habits for specific days only?
faqs.a: Yes! When creating or editing a habit, choose which days of the week it should be active. It will only appear on those days.

faqs.q: How do I delete or archive a habit?
faqs.a: Swipe left on a habit or go to its edit screen and tap Delete. You can also archive habits to keep their history without cluttering your dashboard.

faqs.q: Is my data synced across devices?
faqs.a: Yes, once you sign in with your account, all habits, streaks, and stats sync automatically across your devices.

faqs.q: How do I reset my streak?
faqs.a: Streaks reset automatically if you miss a day. There is no manual reset option to ensure accurate tracking.

faqs.q: Can I export my habit data?
faqs.a: Premium users can export their habit history and statistics as CSV or PDF from the Settings screen.

faqs.q: How do I provide feedback or report a bug?
faqs.a: Go to Settings → Help & Feedback. You can send us a message directly from within the app and our team will respond promptly.

faqs.q: How do I cancel my subscription?
faqs.a: Cancel through the App Store (iOS) or Google Play Store (Android) subscription management page.

faqs.q: How do I delete my account?
faqs.a: Go to Settings → Account Actions → Delete Account. This will permanently remove all your data.

faqs.q: What happens to my data if I uninstall the app?
faqs.a: If you have an account, your data remains saved in the cloud. Reinstall and sign in to restore everything. Without an account, local data will be lost.

It provides personalized care guidance and a dedicated AI chat to answer your specific gardening questions, helping you grow smarter every day.

faqs.q: Why can't I identify more plants?
faqs.a: Free users are limited to 2 successful plant identifications per day. Once you have reached this limit, you will need to wait for it to reset every 24 hours. To remove these restrictions and enjoy unlimited identifications immediately, you can upgrade your account to Premium.

faqs.q: How does plant identification work?

faqs.q: Do I need to create an account?
faqs.a: Plantzy AI allows you to browse as a guest; however, guest data is stored only on your local device. This means your collection may be lost if the app is deleted, the device cache is cleared, or storage is deleted. Creating an account ensures your data is securely saved and synced across all your devices.

faqs.q: What happens to my data if I delete the app?
faqs.a: If you have an account, your data is stored securely on our servers and restored when you sign in again. Guest data stored on the device will be lost. You can also request account deletion anytime from Settings.

faqs.q: What's the difference between free and premium?
faqs.a: Free users have limits on identifications, plant details access, and collections, and can view 1 Plant of the Day. Premium removes these limits and provides full access to all features, including unlimited AI chat.

faqs.q: Can I cancel my subscription?
faqs.a: Yes, you can cancel your subscription at any time through the App Store or Google Play Store settings, depending on your device. Once canceled, your Premium access will continue until the end of your current billing period, after which your account will return to the free tier. By staying subscribed, you ensure uninterrupted access to all Premium benefits. If you choose to cancel, you can always resubscribe later at any time.

faqs.a: You can organize plants using Identified, Wishlist, Indoor and Outdoor collections. Premium users can create unlimited custom collections and categorize plants in multiple ways.

faqs.a: You can identify a plant with the camera, mark plants as Wishlist in the Global Catalogue, or manually create a new entry with details and photos.

faqs.q: How accurate is plant identification?

faqs.q: What is Shroom AI?
faqs.a: Shroom AI is an all-in-one app that helps you identify mushrooms instantly using your camera, organize your discoveries in personal Collections, and explore our extensive Global Mushroom Catalogue. Get answers to your mushroom-related questions through our dedicated AI chat, connect with fellow enthusiasts on the Community Feed, discover fascinating species with Mushroom of the Day, and enjoy interactive features like the "Which Mushroom Are You?" personality quiz. Whether you're a curious beginner or an experienced forager, Shroom AI makes exploring the world of fungi simple, educational, and enjoyable.

faqs.q: Why can't I identify more mushrooms?
faqs.a: Free users are limited to 2 successful mushroom identifications per day. Once you have reached this limit, you will need to wait for it to reset every 24 hours. To remove these restrictions and enjoy unlimited identifications immediately, you can upgrade your account to Premium.

faqs.q: How does mushroom identification work?
faqs.a: Simply snap or upload a clear photo of a mushroom using the Identify feature. Our AI analyzes the images and provides a list of possible matches, each with an accuracy score to help you evaluate the results. Tap on any match to view detailed information, including its common and scientific names, edibility, safety warnings, physical characteristics, habitat, distribution, look-alike species, and more. Free users can identify up to 2 mushrooms per day, while Premium users enjoy unlimited identifications.

faqs.q: Do I need to create an account?
faqs.a: Shroom AI allows you to browse as a guest; however, guest data is stored only on your local device. This means your collection may be lost if the app is deleted, the device cache is cleared, or storage is deleted. Creating an account ensures your data is securely saved and synced across all your devices.

faqs.q: What happens to my data if I delete the app?
faqs.a: If you have an account, your data is stored securely on our servers and restored when you sign in again. Guest data stored on the device will be lost. You can also request account deletion anytime from Settings.

faqs.q: What's the difference between free and premium?
faqs.a: Free users can identify mushrooms, build collections, explore the Global Catalogue, use AI chat, and participate in the Community Feed with certain usage limits. Premium removes these limits and unlocks full access to detailed mushroom information, unlimited identifications, collections, AI chat, Community features, and more.

faqs.q: Can I cancel my subscription?
faqs.a: Yes, you can cancel your subscription at any time through the App Store or Google Play Store settings, depending on your device. Once canceled, your Premium access will continue until the end of your current billing period, after which your account will return to the free tier. By staying subscribed, you ensure uninterrupted access to all Premium benefits. If you choose to cancel, you can always resubscribe later at any time.

faqs.q: How do I organise my mushroom collection?
faqs.a: You can organize mushrooms using the built-in Owned, Identified, and Wishlist collections, as well as custom collections you create yourself. This makes it easy to track, categorize, and revisit your discoveries. Free users can create up to 2 custom collections and save up to 50 mushrooms, while Premium users have unlimited collections and storage.

faqs.q: How do I add mushrooms to my collection?
faqs.a: You can add mushrooms to your collections by saving identification results, adding species from the Global Catalogue to your Wishlist, or organizing mushrooms within custom collections created from the Collections page. Whether you're tracking discoveries, building a wishlist, or organizing your finds, Shroom AI makes it easy to manage your personal mushroom library.

faqs.q: What is "Which mushroom are you"?
faqs.a: "Which Mushroom Are You?" is a fun personality quiz that helps you discover your mushroom counterpart. Answer a series of relatable questions and we'll match you with a mushroom that best reflects your personality. You'll receive a personalized result, learn what makes your mushroom unique, and be able to share your match with friends.

faqs.q: What is the community Feed?
faqs.a: The Community Feed is a space where mushroom enthusiasts can connect, share discoveries, post photos, exchange experiences, and learn from one another. Whether you've found an interesting species, want to ask a question, or simply share your passion for fungi, the Feed helps you engage with the Shroom AI community. Free users can create 1 post per day, while Premium users enjoy greater flexibility. Upgrade to Premium to enjoy a more active community experience with no restrictions.

faqs.q: How does AI chat work?
faqs.a: Ask AI is your personal mushroom assistant. Whether you're curious about a species, need help understanding mushroom characteristics, want foraging tips, or simply wish to expand your knowledge, Ask AI is available to provide guidance and insights whenever you need it. Free users can send up to 5 messages per day to Ask AI. Upgrade to Premium for uninterrupted access and unlimited conversations with Ask AI.

faqs.q: What is the Global Catalogue?
faqs.a: The Global Catalogue is Shroom AI's comprehensive mushroom database, giving you access to thousands of mushroom species from around the world. Browse detailed information about each species. You can also add mushrooms directly to your Wishlist to keep track of species you'd like to find, learn about, or collect in the future. Whether you're researching a mushroom, expanding your knowledge, or exploring new discoveries, the Global Catalogue is your go-to resource for learning about fungi.

faqs.q: What is Mushroom of the Day?
faqs.a: Mushroom of the Day is your daily dose of fungal discovery. Each day, Shroom AI showcases a featured mushroom along with interesting insights to help you expand your knowledge of fungi. Free users can explore one featured mushroom per day. Upgrade to Premium to refresh and discover unlimited Mushrooms of the Day.

faqs.q: How accurate is the mushroom identification?
faqs.a: Shroom AI uses AI to analyze your photos and provide multiple possible matches, each with a confidence score to help you evaluate the results. For the most accurate identification, ensure your photos are well-lit, in focus, and clearly show the mushroom from one or more angles. While Shroom AI can be a valuable identification tool, you should always verify edibility and safety with a qualified expert before consuming any wild mushroom.

faqs.q: Is my personal information secure?
faqs.a: Yes. We take privacy and security seriously. Your data is securely stored and protected using industry-standard security measures. For more information about how we collect, use, and safeguard your information, please refer to our Privacy Policy and Terms of Service.

faqs.q: How do I report inappropriate content?
faqs.a: If you come across content that violates our community guidelines, you can use the Report option available on the relevant post or content. Our team reviews all reports and takes appropriate action to help maintain a safe and welcoming community for everyone.

faqs.q: Can I export my collection data?
faqs.a: Collection export is not currently available. However, your collections and saved mushrooms are securely stored and automatically synced across all devices where you're signed in to your Shroom AI account.
